topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't believe it. After all these months, chatting every day, sharing everything, it turns out Alex lives just a few blocks away. I mean, what are the odds? I've been feeling so alone here, and now this. I don't know what to do. Part of me wants to knock on Alex's door right now, just to see if it's really true. But what if it is? What if everything changes now? I need to talk to someone, but who? I can't keep this inside, but I'm also scared to reach out. What if I mess this up? We've been so good online, just the two of us. I don't want to ruin it. But I can't keep living like this either.
